collection.method: Read-only installed-module inspection on the login node; LAMMPS C API registry introspection with an empty -screen none -log none instance.
caveats: lmp -log none -h failed on the login node with CUDA driver error 100 while querying the GPU package; packages/styles were obtained through liblammps C API instead.
Style registration can include compatibility/deprecation placeholders; the registry is a feature baseline, not proof every style executes.
DeePMD backend names here mean installed native libraries and distribution metadata, not successful model inference.
The standalone TF/JAX backend ldd showed missing TensorFlow libraries with the module alone; Python may pre-load them. Real model execution remains required.
No benchmark or scientific energy/force/virial validation was performed during this collection.

lammps_binary.type: ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, x86-64, dynamically linked

model_search.scope: Known DeePMD/LAMMPS installed prefixes, maximum depth 6.
model_search.available_benchmarks: LAMMPS share/lammps/bench/in.lj, in.eam, and POTENTIALS examples.
model_search.limitation: No installed scientific frozen-model fixture was located; use version-pinned upstream tests.

metadata.cp2k_reuse_observation: controller/cp2k_build.sh loads elpa/2026.02.001-2603-gnu but also prepends explicit CP2K-toolchain ELPA 2024.05.001 paths to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. Selection must be verified from CMake cache/ldd; module load alone does not settle it.
